senses.gloss: m. (מָשַׁךְ) one who has his prepuce drawn forward in order to disguise the sign of the covenant.
units: <cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 15:9">Tosef. Sabb. XV</cite> (<cite ref="Tosefta Shabbat 16:9">XVI</cite>), 9; <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Yevamot 8:1:13">Y. Yeb. VIII, 9ᵃ</cite> top <he>המושך</he> (corr. acc.). Bab.
ib. 72ᵇ מ׳ דאורייתא that a mashukh must be circumcised again is a Biblical injunction; a. fr.—Pl. מְשׁוּכִין. Y. Yeb. l. c.
